control.title: Browser control
control.switchDesc: Enable the official Browser Use plugin so new sessions can visit and operate web pages via the embedded browser
control.rdUnavailable: Unavailable in remote development: the CEF debug channel used by browser tools runs on the local frontend machine
control.readonlyHint: Shared with the ZCode client. To change it, use the settings in the ZCode client (applies to new sessions)

data.title: Browser data
data.clearCacheDesc: Clear HTTP cache, Cache Storage and Service Workers; keeps cookies and local site data
data.clearAllDesc: Deletes cookies, site data and cache in the embedded browser. This cannot be undone
data.timeout: Operation timed out (embedded browser or debug channel unresponsive). Retry or restart the IDE

overview.title: View data overview
overview.note: Sizes are approximate on-disk values and change while the browser runs; pages still in use re-cache their resources right after clearing, so values going back up is normal. Cookies are counted globally; cache/storage counts cover only open tabs; disk sites are markers of historical data.
